unresolved_adjudication_question.question: Does the protocol permit a terminal disposition for unattempted units (ordinals 3-108) based solely on platform retirement, without individual execution?
unresolved_adjudication_question.basis: The frozen experimental protocol (RUN_ORDER_v0_1.json) and existing amendment records do not contain an explicit provision for declaring unattempted units as terminally blocked by platform retirement without individual execution attempt. A receiver-migration amendment (CSH-AMEND-004 proposal, see separate record) is required to address this question. Until that proposal is reviewed, authorized, and executed, the 106 unattempted units retain their 'not_executed' status and do not receive a terminal experimental disposition from this record.
